item.title: AI Isn't Only for Saving on People. It Frees Them to Add More Value
item.description: Image: illustrative — IKEA Billie chatbot and remote design advice AI Isn’t Only for Saving on People. It Frees Them to Add More Value What IKEA did with 8,500 service agents is a lesson most automation projects still haven’t learned. Almost every AI project in customer service is presented the same way: deflected contacts, cost per contact, positions no longer needed. That’s the easy part. And it’s the part that’s worth the least.
